sloka: अथवा ध्रुवमन्येभ्यो भयं परमुपस्थितम् ।यदर्थमेवं त्वरितैर्भवद्भिः प्रतिबोधितः ।। ६.६०.६९ ।।।।
transliteration: athavā dhruvamanyebhyo bhayaṁ paramupasthitam ।yadarthamevaṁ tvaritairbhavadbhiḥ pratibodhitaḥ ।। 6.60.69 ।।।।

translations.english: "For a small reason he will not awaken me. Tell me the reason truly for waking me."
